banner: GENERATE WAVE 2 - DESCENDANTS OF THE TEN - ZERO KNOBS

descendants.extras: Phi(X)=grad_X xi; J=Phi on ker eta
descendants.why: The Levi-Civita connection of locked g5 and the unit Reeb determine Φ, and Φ squared is -1 on the contact distribution.

descendants.extras: base S^2×S^2; omega_T=d eta/2; g_T is not g_mu_nu
descendants.why: g_T is g5 on ker η, pushed to the Reeb quotient. ω_T = dη/2 is basic. The quotient is the locked transverse base. This metric is not g_μν(x).

descendants.extras: Hol=SU(3); complex line of parallel spinors; phase is Iso U(1)
descendants.why: Spin(6) spinors branch as 3⊕1 under SU(3). Exact holonomy SU(3) leaves one complex parallel spinor. The phase is the locked Reeb U(1), not a color factor.

descendants.extras: H^2 ≅ Z^2/Z(1,1); rank 1; not a flux
descendants.why: π*(1,1) is exact. The quotient of base cohomology by the Euler class has rank 1, matching b2. HARM_2 is the harmonic generator of that quotient, up to sign.

descendants.extras: E(j_L,j_R,q) with no cutoff list; Killing eigenvalues ['-5/2', '5/2'] under e·e=+1; scalar Laplacian on cos theta1 gives -12
descendants.why: D5 commutes with the locked Iso, so eigenvalues are a function of irrep labels. No finite list and no j-cutoff are written. The Killing spinors sit at ±5/2. N_gen is not one of those values. The scalar Casimir is a different operator.
sqrt(g)=sin(theta1)*sin(theta2)/108. Euler number 1 fixes ψ period 4*pi. Volume integrates to 16*pi**3/27.
Ric(∂ψ,∂ψ)/g_ψψ at θ=π/2 equals 4. Dimension 5 gives scalar curvature 20.

descendants.extras: L_(r d/dr) g_C = 2 g_C; existing GAUGE; not a GeV
descendants.why: On dr^2+r^2 g5 the radial field r∂_r is the unique homothety of weight 2 with unit ∂r. It is the cone scale already carried as Weyl gauge.
The cone complex structure sends ∂r to the Reeb and restricts to Φ on the link. Wave-1 contact data fix it. No new real parameter.

descendants.extras: II = g5 / r along the radial normal
descendants.why: The level set of r in the cone has second fundamental form g5/r. The cone metric fixes it.
